about.visible.label: Show this page to visitors
about.visible.hint: Off, and the about page disappears from the menu and answers Not Found for everybody except you. Useful while it is still being written.

about.sections.label: Sections, and their order
about.sections.hint: Move a section up or down, or untick it to leave it out. A section you leave out keeps everything in it, so ticking it again brings it back as it was.

about.meta.description.value: Who is behind this practice, where the experience comes from, and how the work is approached.
about.meta.description.label: Search description
about.meta.description.hint: The sentence Google shows under the page title in search results. Around 150 to 160 characters; longer is cut off mid-word.

about.meta.titlePrefix.label: Search title
about.meta.titlePrefix.hint: The left half of the browser tab and search result. The company name is added after it.

about.hero.eyebrow.label: Hero eyebrow
about.hero.eyebrow.hint: The teal hero at the top

about.hero.heading.label: Hero heading
about.hero.heading.hint: The teal hero at the top. A line break splits it in two

about.hero.intro.label: Hero introduction
about.hero.intro.hint: A short introduction to whoever is behind this. Two or three sentences.

about.hero.tags.label: Hero tags
about.hero.tags.hint: One per line, kept to two or three words: where you are based, how long you have been doing this, anything you are known for. Leave empty and no tags appear.

about.story.p1.label: Story, first paragraph
about.story.p1.hint: Where this started. The first job, the thing that did not work, the moment the approach made sense.

about.credentials.heading.label: Credentials heading
about.credentials.heading.hint: The pale card beside the story

about.badges.heading.label: Badges heading
about.badges.heading.hint: The pale card beside the story. The badge images themselves are set in code

about.badges.list.label: Credential badges
about.badges.list.hint: One badge per line, as: name | image address | link to the verification page. Leave empty and the badges do not appear. These are somebody’s own credentials, so they start empty on a new site.

about.work.label.label: Work with me eyebrow
about.work.label.hint: The dark teal box under the credentials

about.work.body.value: Not sure where to start? A chemistry session is a free 30-minute conversation - no agenda, no commitment.
about.work.body.label: Work with me body
about.work.body.hint: The dark teal box under the credentials

about.work.cta.label: Work with me button
about.work.cta.hint: The dark teal box under the credentials

about.feedback.label.label: Testimonials eyebrow
about.feedback.label.hint: Above the quotes, which come from the database

about.mission.p1.value: Most agile training is too abstract. It describes frameworks without connecting them to real problems. It teaches the events without explaining why they exist. It certifies people who leave the course without knowing what to do on Monday morning.
about.mission.p1.label: Mission, first paragraph

about.mission.p2.label: Mission, second paragraph
about.mission.p2.hint: The sentence at the centre of this page. What this practice is for.

about.mission.p3.value: Every course, every coaching conversation, and every technique in the knowledge base is designed to be immediately usable - not a concept to be filed away for later. That means real scenarios, honest facilitation, and a trainer who's been in the room for real.
about.mission.p3.label: Mission, third paragraph

about.philosophy.items.label: Philosophy cards
about.philosophy.items.hint: One card per side of what you do. Each has a short tag, a heading, a paragraph, a list of principles one per line, and a colour. Leave the colour empty and the card takes one from the set the site ships with. Leave the whole list empty and the section disappears.

about.timeline.label.label: Timeline eyebrow
about.timeline.label.hint: Above the career timeline. The entries themselves are still in code

about.timeline.list.label: Timeline entries
about.timeline.list.hint: One entry per line, as: when | what it was called | what happened. For example "2016 | Going independent | Left the corporate world to do this full time." The last entry is marked Now. Leave empty and the timeline does not appear.

about.cta.label.label: Closing eyebrow
about.cta.label.hint: The dark teal band at the foot of the page

about.cta.heading.value: Ready to work with someone who's been in the room?
about.cta.heading.label: Closing heading
about.cta.heading.hint: The dark teal band at the foot of the page

about.cta.body.value: Browse upcoming courses, explore the knowledge base, or book a free chemistry session to talk through what you need.
about.cta.body.label: Closing body
about.cta.body.hint: The dark teal band at the foot of the page

about.cta.booking.label: Closing button, booking
about.cta.booking.hint: The dark teal band at the foot of the page

about.cta.events.label: Closing link, events
about.cta.events.hint: The dark teal band at the foot of the page

about.cta.knowledge.label: Closing link, knowledge base
about.cta.knowledge.hint: The dark teal band at the foot of the page. Only shown when that module is on

about.founder.role.label: Founder role
about.founder.role.hint: The job title given in structured data for the person who founded this business.
